title: SpriteMotion game adapter descriptor
description: Declares one game folder under games/: its extraction adapter, profiles, skeletons and bundled annotation sets. Everything game-specific is reached through this file.

module.description: Python file relative to the game folder.

source_hint.description: What the user should point the extractor at.

profile.description: Path to the character profile, relative to the game folder.

skeleton.description: Path to the skeleton, relative to the game folder.

annotations.description: Folder with estimates/ and corrections/, relative to the game folder.

sequences.description: Optional sequence catalog, relative to the game folder.
